data: synthetic: i.i.d. uniform ACGT references; no real genomes were used

design.bytes_per_ref: exact: 8 bytes per distinct k-mer; minhash: 8 bytes per retained hash; sdr: 4 bytes per active index (engine sorted-u32 form)
design.noise_model: per-base independent; substitution to one of the other 3 bases; indel position is a deletion or insertion of a random base with equal probability
design.orientation: each read is reverse-complemented with probability 0.5
design.rank_policy: rank = 1 + number of other references scoring >= the source reference (ties count against the method)
